decision: Deletion of lap time (1:11.829) in accordance with Article 12.3.1.e of the FIA International Sporting Code and Art 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
event_name: Haas F1 Team Document 44 Date 05 July 2020 Time 15:37 2020 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 2 - 5 July 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 8 did not use the track at the exit of turn 9.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Ch IV, Article 2c of the FIA International Sporting Code and failure to follow the Race Director's Race Notes 21.1.a).
penalty: Deletion of lap time (1:11.829) in accordance with Article 12.3.1.e of the FIA International Sporting Code and Art 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and received timing information from the Race Director. The car left the track. The penalty was applied in accordance with point 21.1. a) of the Race Directors Event Notes and Article 12.3.1.e of the FIA International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 8 Track Limits Turn 9
